card.name: Last item before a closing bracket
card.fires_on: The final token just before a closing square bracket or parenthesis, such as a number, a percent sign, or a short label inside [ ] brackets. Also fires once on the verb 'arresting' before 'innocent'.

modes.label: Inside square brackets
modes.description: The last element inside brackets, right before the closing bracket.

modes.label: Citation before closing
modes.description: A section number or label ending a bracketed cross-reference.

modes.label: Verb before innocent
modes.example: for not<< arresting>> innocent people," Todorov said,

card.writes: It promotes odd tie-like and Chinese tokens and suppresses 'innocent' and bracket-closing tokens, so there is no clean output story.
card.plain: It lights up on the last item inside brackets, just before the bracket closes.
